examples.text: Шеф, тут много рыбы, всем хватит.
examples.trans: Chef, there is plenty of fish here, enough for everyone.

examples.text: Девочки, хватит секретничать, мы похищаем невесту!
examples.trans: Girls, enough whispering, we are kidnapping the bride!

examples.text: Денег не хватило.
examples.trans: There wasn't enough money.

meanings.note: Prefix 'с-' ('together' or 'down from') marks convergence or completion (root 'екретничать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to whispering'.

examples.text: Девочки, хватит секретничать, мы похищаем невесту!
examples.trans: Girls, enough whispering, we are kidnapping the bride!

examples.text: Скажите, а сколько это может стоить?
examples.trans: Tell me, how much could this be worth?

meanings.note: High-frequency Russian pronoun ('we') that declines for case depending on its grammatical function in the sentence.

examples.text: Ну да, мы с Мишей женимся.
examples.trans: Well yes, Misha and I are getting married.

examples.text: Саша, мы разве не решили вопросы?
examples.trans: Sasha, didn't we settle all the questions?

examples.text: Вот, видишь, мы действительно заняты.
examples.trans: There, you see, we really are booked.

meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (root 'хищать'). Used in Russian as an perfective verb focusing on a single completed action or result meaning 'to bride'.

examples.text: Девочки, хватит секретничать, мы похищаем невесту!
examples.trans: Girls, enough whispering, we are kidnapping the bride!

examples.text: Скажите, а сколько это может стоить?
examples.trans: Tell me, how much could this be worth?

meanings.note: Declinable feminine noun meaning 'bride', changing its case ending across all six Russian grammatical cases to mark its role in the clause.

examples.text: Девочки, хватит секретничать, мы похищаем невесту!
examples.trans: Girls, enough whispering, we are kidnapping the bride!

examples.text: Вика стала его невестой.
examples.trans: Vika became his fiancée.

examples.text: Теперь мы станем настоящими женихом и невестой!
examples.trans: Now we will become real groom and bride!
